blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust applied to Media & Entertainment. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Media economics are attention economics: commissioning, scheduling, promotion and rights all price against predicted engagement. Studios and broadcasters that industrialize audience intelligence and content-operations automation compound catalog value instead of renting it.

items: Royalty/rights accounting bilateral; disputes take quarters.

Governance inherits the sector frame — Privacy (CDPA/GDPR-class) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
